# Errors

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the docstrings of the lakana package. Do not edit by hand:
run `uv run python scripts/generate_reference.py` and commit the result. -->

The errors the `lakana` package exports and what each means; each method of the client names the ones it raises.

## `lakana.ArtifactCorrupt`

Subclass of `lakana.LakanaError`.

A downloaded artifact did not match its manifest; nothing of it was kept.

## `lakana.AuthenticationError`

Subclass of `lakana.LakanaError`.

The server rejected the request's credentials (HTTP 401).

## `lakana.ConfigError`

Subclass of `lakana.LakanaError`.

The SDK's configuration could not be resolved.

## `lakana.Conflict`

Subclass of `lakana.LakanaError`.

The request conflicts with the resource's current state (HTTP 409).

## `lakana.DeployFailed`

Subclass of `lakana.LakanaError`.

A deploy, dry run or rollback ended in the `failed` state.

Signature: `lakana.DeployFailed(message: str, deploy: Deploy)`

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | `str` | required | The run's `error_message`. |
| `deploy` | `Deploy` | required | The failed run. |

## `lakana.InvalidResponse`

Subclass of `lakana.LakanaError`.

The server answered with a body that is not the JSON the SDK expects (a wrong URL?).

## `lakana.JobStartsNotRecorded`

Subclass of `TimeoutError`.

A deploy succeeded, but the jobs it starts were not all recorded before the timeout.

A `TimeoutError`, so code that catches the timeout of `Deploys.wait` still catches it. The deploy itself is done; the worker records each start of an ``on_deploy`` job right after it, so reading the deploy again later shows what came of each.

Signature: `lakana.JobStartsNotRecorded(message: str, deploy: Deploy)`

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | `str` | required | What happened. |
| `deploy` | `Deploy` | required | The succeeded deploy, with each start not yet recorded as ``pending``. |

## `lakana.LakanaConnectionError`

Subclass of `lakana.LakanaError`.

The server could not be reached at all.

## `lakana.LakanaError`

Subclass of `Exception`.

Base class for every error raised by the Lakana SDK.

Signature: `lakana.LakanaError(message: str, *, status: int | None = None, error_type: str | None = None, retry_after: str | None = None)`

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | `str` | required | A human-readable description of the failure. |
| `status` | `int | None` | `None` | The HTTP status code that produced this error, if any. |
| `error_type` | `str | None` | `None` | The server's own `type` field from the error body, if any. |
| `retry_after` | `str | None` | `None` | The response's `Retry-After` header as it was sent (text, not parsed), if any. |

## `lakana.NotFound`

Subclass of `lakana.LakanaError`.

The requested resource does not exist (HTTP 404).

## `lakana.PayloadTooLarge`

Subclass of `lakana.LakanaError`.

The request body exceeded the server's size limit (HTTP 413).

## `lakana.PermissionDenied`

Subclass of `lakana.LakanaError`.

The credentials are valid but lack the right to do this (HTTP 403).

## `lakana.QueryFailed`

Subclass of `lakana.LakanaError`.

A submitted query run ended in the `FAILED` or `CANCELLED` state.

Signature: `lakana.QueryFailed(message: str, *, cause: str | None = None)`

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | `str` | required | The run's `error_message`. |
| `cause` | `str | None` | `None` | The server's machine-readable cause (`not_found`, `permission_denied`, `result_too_large`, `invalid_query`, `out_of_memory`, `timeout`, `cancelled`, `worker_lost` or `internal`; a value this SDK does not know is possible), or `None` when the server did not send one: an older server, or a run that failed without one. |

## `lakana.RunFailed`

Subclass of `lakana.LakanaError`.

A run ended `failed` or `cancelled`.

Signature: `lakana.RunFailed(message: str, run: Run)`

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | `str` | required | What happened. |
| `run` | `Run` | required | The finished run. |

## `lakana.ServerError`

Subclass of `lakana.LakanaError`.

The server failed unexpectedly (HTTP 5xx).

## `lakana.ValidationError`

Subclass of `lakana.LakanaError`.

The request was structurally invalid (HTTP 422).
